global_signals.name: clock
global_signals.semantics: Bus clock. Inputs are sampled on the rising edge. Both master and slave on a link share the same clock.

global_signals.name: reset
global_signals.semantics: Bus reset. Active HIGH. May be asserted asynchronously, must be deasserted synchronous with rising edge of clock.

channels.name: A
channels.purpose: Carries request messages sent to a particular address.

signals.name: a_opcode
signals.semantics: Operation code. Identifies message type per Table 5.2.

signals.name: a_param
signals.semantics: Parameter code. Meaning depends on a_opcode (sub-opcode or permissions Grow category).

signals.name: a_size
signals.semantics: Logarithm of the operation size: 2^a_size bytes.

signals.name: a_source
signals.semantics: Unique, per-link master source identifier.

signals.name: a_address
signals.semantics: Target byte address of the operation. Must be aligned to a_size.

signals.name: a_mask
signals.semantics: Byte lane select for messages with data.

signals.name: a_data
signals.semantics: Data payload for messages with data.

signals.name: a_valid
signals.semantics: Channel carries valid data.

signals.name: a_ready
signals.semantics: Channel data was accepted.

channels.name: B
channels.purpose: Carries request messages sent to a particular cached data block held by a particular master.

signals.name: b_opcode
signals.semantics: Operation code per Table 5.2.

signals.name: b_param
signals.semantics: Parameter code; Cap category {toN, toB, toT} for Probe.

signals.name: b_size
signals.semantics: Log2 of operation size.

signals.name: b_source
signals.semantics: Unique, per-link master source identifier (target of probe).

signals.name: b_address
signals.semantics: Target byte address.

signals.name: b_mask
signals.semantics: Byte lane select for messages with data.

signals.name: b_data
signals.semantics: Data payload.

signals.name: b_valid
signals.semantics: Channel carries valid data.

signals.name: b_ready
signals.semantics: Channel data was accepted.

channels.name: C
channels.purpose: Carries response messages to channel-B requests; also used to voluntarily write back dirty cached data.

signals.name: c_param
signals.semantics: Sub-opcode / permissions Prune category for Release; Shrink or Report for ProbeAck.

signals.name: c_error
signals.semantics: Master agent was unable to service the request.

channels.name: D
channels.purpose: Carries response messages for channel-A requests; also acknowledges channel-C voluntary writebacks (ReleaseAck) and channel-B Probes' triggering Acquire (Grant/GrantData).

signals.name: d_param
signals.semantics: Permissions Cap category for Grant/GrantData ({toT, toB, toN}); reserved 0 elsewhere.

signals.name: d_source
signals.semantics: Unique per-link master source identifier; echoes a_source / c_source.

signals.name: d_sink
signals.semantics: Unique per-link slave sink identifier; used for GrantAck pairing.

signals.name: d_error
signals.semantics: Slave was unable to service the request.

channels.name: E
channels.full_name: Channel E — Master-to-Slave Final Handshake (TL-C only)
channels.purpose: Carries acknowledgements of receipt of channel-D response messages (GrantAck), used for operation serialization.

signals.name: e_sink
signals.semantics: Unique per-link slave sink identifier; echoes d_sink of the Grant being acknowledged.

fields.signal_naming_convention: Other than clock and reset, TileLink signal names consist of the channel identifier (a-e) followed by an underscore, followed by the name of the signal. For devices with multiple TileLink interfaces, signal names should be prefixed with a descriptive token plus underscore (e.g. gpio_a_opcode).
